verdict.rationale: Jina Reader's entire design purpose is to convert a URL into 'clean, LLM-ready text' (markdown, frontmatter, JSON) rather than preserve raw HTML — the evidence pack's only documented `x-respond-with` values are markdown-based outputs (frontmatter, chunked markdown), with no mention of a raw-HTML response option. Since the product explicitly transforms/cleans content instead of returning unprocessed HTML, there is no evidence it satisfies a 'get raw HTML back' request.
